data.message: Drafting will happen as a series of background processes. You have to implement a background task that downloads all the data. Drafting will add a rank to each person. You will have to migrate your database to support that. Each drafting batch must happen as a separate background task call. Once a batch is downloaded, its drafting background task can already start. Configure retry policies on the task (see https://docs.celeryq.dev/en/stable/userguide/tasks.html) if a batch times out (it might happen). Hellstorm Fireburn's key attribute will tell you once again where to go next.
